Simulate cache

Source: R/utils_simulate.R
simulate_cache.Rd

Simulate a cache.

Usage

simulate_cache(x, n = 10)

Arguments

x

sf::st_sf() object.

n

integer number of solutions to create in the cache.

Value

A list object.

See also

Other functions for simulating data: simulate_binary_legend(), simulate_continuous_legend(), simulate_pmtiles_file(), simulate_prioritization_settings(), simulate_project(), simulate_provenance(), simulate_solution_legend(), simulate_spatial_data()

Examples

# simulate data
d <- simulate_spatial_data()

# simulate cache
sim_cache <- simulate_cache(d)

# preview cache
print(sim_cache)
